text:
ben_k: Heads-up: planning a stepwise canary for model-serving v1.3. Start 2026-03-25 20:00 UTC. Need deployer, smoke owner, rollback ready. Ramp plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% with 30m step windows and 10m pause for health checks between steps. Cohorts: internal, small-cust, geo-us-west. Any blockers?
carla-pl: I can deploy. Prefer a 5m smoke after each step (run smoke script + quick golden-check). No blockers on my end.
alice: I’ll own smoke checks — perf + correctness. I’ll run p50/p95, error-rate, and a tiny eval set. Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/model-serving (will paste direct panels when we start).
dan: I’ll own rollback. Snapshotting current state now and pinning v1.2. Rollback command ready: `./deploy rollback --to v1.2`.
ben_k: Thanks. Carla, can you trigger step 1 and post status updates here? Also please tag me and @alice after each step.
carla-pl: yep. Tentative timeline: step1 20:00 UTC (1%), step2 20:40 UTC (5%), step3 21:20 UTC (20%). I'll post exact timestamps when we hit each point.
evelyn: I’ll monitor infra autoscaler and GPU pool. If we see >1.5x baseline scale or unexpected queue growth, I’ll throttle routing and notify ops.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preflight checks complete — infra-health=ok, model-artifacts=verified, canary-traffic-route=ready.
alice: Quick smoke checklist: 1) sample-gen ok 2) p50 < 120ms 3) p95 < 400ms 4) error-rate < 0.5% 5) eval prompt sanity pass. If any fail, call for immediate rollback.
carla-pl: Posting deploy command for reference:
```
./deploy canary --model v1.3 --cohort internal --percent 1 --duration 30m
```
dan: If we need to rollback, plan is: 1) decision in thread or voice, 2) drain incoming queues (coordinate with oncall), 3) run rollback command, 4) validate basic smoke. ETA for rollback < 8m after decision.
ben_k: :thumbsup: All good. If nobody objects, we’ll proceed as planned. @alice tag me immediately on any failing check, otherwise I’ll watch dashboards.
evelyn: Opening a temporary alert channel and adding a short runbook snippet (will link here).
carla-pl: :rocket: Starting step1 at 20:00 UTC, will post live updates in this thread as steps complete.
